exclusions: IME candidates and OS file/data drag-and-drop
notes: Individual TRX outcomes are authoritative; raw xUnit/VSTest summary counters are retained because Explicit cases can be omitted from summary notExecuted counts.

Screenshots were validated through actual Headless rendering, native WinForms SDK capture and real stdio MCP application/common-dialog captures. Pure geometry and synthetic provider tests are separate evidence layers.
Native capture uses the scoped PrintWindow surface, never arbitrary desktop capture. Protected/GPU renderers can be unsupported or incomplete; known unpainted marker pixels are rejected.
WinEvent lifetime checks enforce observed destruction and are asynchronous, not atomic window pinning. Forced PID reuse and actual OS partial input failures remain unverified boundaries.
